### Slip the Rush

*As the pursuer lunges into reach, it ducks sideways through the space the rush left open.*

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to this creature, move up to 1 square without provoking from that enemy. Other opportunity attacks and normal terrain costs apply. This movement grants no attack; it cannot trigger from forced movement or movement granted by a free attack.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Roll Away:** Normal terrain costs and occupied-square restrictions apply.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Bright scraps are tied to trip-free routes through the rubble.

**Purpose:** Protect a salvage claim and avoid being cheated.

**Tactics and retreat:** Roll Away between cover and a distracted opponent; bargain when cornered.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Recognize the salvage claim or trade a useful tool.

**Habitat:** Ruin; roadside · **Communication:** Common and Goblin

**Loot:** Melee weapon, tool scraps and 3 coins.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-goblin-scrapper


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Scavenger · **CV:** 8

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scrap knife | Agility | None | 2 physical damage. | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 2/3/5

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.2

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.1 → 1.2: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=2.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [roll away](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/roll-away.md), [Slip the Rush](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/slip-the-rush.md).
